# Research experience report template

Follow [GRS report readiness](../research-standard.md#lessons-and-paper-style-experience-reports).
Replace prompts with evidence-backed text. This is a template, not a result.

Report classification: development / independently validated / negative-results.
Cycle, standard, frozen plan, authorship/assistance, date, code and data identity.

## Abstract

Question, method, principal quantitative finding, counterevidence and scope limit.

## 1. Question and contribution

Why this question matters, incumbent weakness and what new information was gained.

## 2. Related work and provenance

Primary references, pinned implementations, reuse rights and material adaptations.

## 3. Data and information timing

Universe, dates, actions, availability, label maturity, viewed-data exposure and rights.

## 4. Methods and experimental design

Rules, controls, capital, costs/financing, decision/fill timing, trial counts/budget,
frozen criteria, chronology and explicit departures. Separate fitted choices.

## 5. Results

Net results against every control; full and annual return/DD/Sharpe/Calmar;
underwater depth/duration/censoring, exposure, turnover/costs and attribution.
Link exact artifact sources for each table/figure and preserve undefined metrics.

## 6. Robustness and counterevidence

Declared cost/timing challenges, simpler alternatives, failures and unfavorable eras.

## 7. Interpretation and limitations

What is supported, plausible alternatives, multiple testing, realism/independence,
what remains unassessed and why this is not operational promotion.

## 8. Reproducibility

Immutable plans/input/code hashes, commands/exits, manifests, environments, audits
and access restrictions. Replay/audit instructions must not restart closed budgets.

## 9. Lessons and next question

Actionable learning, disposition and smallest new evidence requirement; no tuning
until favorable. Distinguish a useful rejection from a financial improvement.

## References

Primary sources and authoritative experiment receipts; no copied performance claims.
